sections.chapter_title: Universal serial bus full-speed host/device interface (USB)
sections.section_title: Double buffered channels: usage in Host mode
sections.text_helper: Section 47.5.4 "Double buffered channels: usage in Host mode" in chapter 47 (Universal serial bus full-speed host/device interface (USB)), RM0522 Rev 1, page 2101.
sections.section_content:
In Host mode the underlying transmit and receive methods for double buffered channels are
the same as those described for Device mode.
Similar to the Device mode table, a new table below Table490: Bulk double-buffering
memory buffers usage (Host mode) shows the programming settings for OUT and IN
tokens.
[Table 490. Bulk double-buffering memory buffers usage (Host mode)]
